prompt.title: LinkedIn creator content analytics portable actions
prompt.instructions: Operate only the user-authorized LinkedIn creator content analytics page. Prefer portable primitives. Use horizon snapshots to infer post-level time attribution by subtracting rolling-window totals.
prompt.state_summary: The page exposes rolling horizons such as 7 days, 14 days, 28 days, 90 days, and 365 days. The aggregate export gives daily totals, but the top-performing post table gives only cumulative post totals for the selected horizon. Capturing the same post rows at multiple horizons allows approximate week-by-week attribution by subtraction.

states.name: creator_content_analytics_visible
states.description: The browser is on LinkedIn creator content analytics.

states.name: horizon_menu_open
states.description: The date-range menu is open and horizon options can be resolved to viewport coordinates.

states.name: horizon_results_applied
states.description: The chosen horizon has been applied by pressing Show results, and the body text reflects the selected horizon.

states.name: metric_menu_open
states.description: The metric menu is open and metric options can be resolved to viewport coordinates.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.read_visible_analytics
tools.description: Read the visible creator content analytics page text, including selected horizon, chart point count, aggregate metrics, and visible top-performing post rows.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.metric_impressions_info
tools.description: Resolve the Impressions metric label or open-menu option to viewport geometry. If it is the active label, click the returned center to open the metric menu; if the menu is already open, click the returned center to choose Impressions.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.metric_engagements_info
tools.description: Resolve the Engagements metric label or open-menu option to viewport geometry. If it is the active label, click the returned center to open the metric menu; if the menu is already open, click the returned center to choose Engagements.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.horizon_7_days_info
tools.description: Resolve the 7 days horizon label or open-menu option to viewport geometry. If it is the active label, click the returned center to open the menu; if the menu is already open, click the returned center to choose this horizon.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.horizon_14_days_info
tools.description: Resolve the 14 days horizon label or open-menu option to viewport geometry. If it is the active label, click the returned center to open the menu; if the menu is already open, click the returned center to choose this horizon.

tools.description: Resolve the 28 days horizon label or open-menu option to viewport geometry. If it is the active label, click the returned center to open the menu; if the menu is already open, click the returned center to choose this horizon.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.horizon_90_days_info
tools.description: Resolve the 90 days horizon label or open-menu option to viewport geometry. If it is the active label, click the returned center to open the menu; if the menu is already open, click the returned center to choose this horizon.

tools.description: Resolve the 365 days horizon label or open-menu option to viewport geometry. If it is the active label, click the returned center to open the menu; if the menu is already open, click the returned center to choose this horizon.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.show_results_info
tools.description: Resolve the Show results control in the open horizon menu. Click the returned center to apply the selected horizon.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.export_info
tools.description: Resolve the Export control for the selected horizon. The exported XLSX provides aggregate daily rows and top-post cumulative totals for the selected range.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.visible_controls.read
tools.description: Read visible links/buttons/controls on the page. Useful for authoring and for confirming the active horizon control is reachable without debug JavaScript.

tools.name: linkedin.creator_content.capture_authoring_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a rendered screenshot for LinkedIn authoring diagnostics. This is privileged in the extension and user-consented in bookmarklet/embed-style runtimes.

workflows.name: collect_metric_snapshot
workflows.description: Use the fixed metric info tool for the current active metric to open the metric menu, use the fixed metric info tool for the desired metric to resolve the menu option, pointer.click to select it, show_results_info plus pointer.click to apply it, then read_visible_analytics to capture the metric snapshot.
workflows.note: The metric menu does not apply on option click alone; Show results must be clicked before the page updates.

workflows.name: collect_horizon_snapshot
workflows.description: Use the fixed horizon info tool for the current active horizon to open the range menu, use the fixed horizon info tool for the desired horizon to resolve the menu option, pointer.click to select it, show_results_info plus pointer.click to apply it, then read_visible_analytics to capture the horizon snapshot.
workflows.note: The horizon menu does not apply on option click alone; Show results must be clicked before the page updates.
